genre: spooky/moody/eerie but playful magic flute music
performance_description: Doodel plays a conjured magic flute of unknown origin that is able to play several voices at the same time. Example: "Darkmoon Faire Carusel Theme" (from WoW), and "This is Halloween" (from "A Nightmare Before Christmas") This flute concert however has lowest priority of the all the performances I might get involved with at this Roaring Days festival though.
